abn.description: The 11-digit Australian Business Number; the shelf's subject and its SERIES identity.

acn.description: The 9-digit Australian Company Number, when the entity is a company.

entity_name.description: The registered entity name as published by the register.

entity_type.description: The register's entity-type name (company / trust / partnership / sole trader, as published).

gst_registered.description: Whether the entity is GST-registered (may be `false`; the field must be present).

gst_registered_from.description: Effective date of GST registration, when registered.

jurisdiction_code.description: Jurisdiction the registration belongs to; today always Australia and **NULL on every write**.

observed_at.description: When this registration snapshot was observed; drives freshness ordering.

status.description: Registration status at observation time (e.g. active / cancelled).

trading_names.description: Trading names the register publishes for the ABN.
